name: NGC 4618 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4618, a barred spiral galaxy with a single arm, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4618-hubble
story: A barred spiral with only one arm winding around its center, locked in a gravitational dance with its neighbor NGC 4625 that may one day merge them into something new, perhaps a ring galaxy.

claims.text: NGC 4618 is a barred spiral galaxy
It has only one arm winding around its center
It forms an interacting pair with NGC 4625
The interaction may lead to a merger, possibly a ring galaxy
